checks.text: The page heading is "Comic Book Reader" and the drop zone shows the text "Drop a CBZ or CBR file here".
After dropping a CBZ file named "test-comic.cbz" containing 3 pages, the PagedReader shows page 1 of 3, the progress indicator reads "1/3", and the page image is visible.
Clicking the button "Next page" advances to page 2; the progress indicator reads "2/3" and the page image changes to the second image in the archive.
On page 2, clicking the button "Add bookmark" adds a bookmark entry labelled "Page 2" to the bookmark list; the bookmark list now contains one item with the text "Page 2".
Clicking the button "Remove bookmark" on the bookmark entry "Page 2" removes it from the list; the bookmark list shows the text "No bookmarks yet".
Clicking the button "Export page" downloads a file named "test-comic-page-2.png" containing the current page image encoded as PNG.
In the settings panel, changing the select labelled "Page size" from "Fit width" to "Fit page" causes the page image to render at a different scale; the select value reads "Fit page".
The tab labelled "Bookmarks" shows the bookmark list; after adding a bookmark on page 1 and switching to the Bookmarks tab, the list contains an entry with the text "Page 1".
Reload keeps the loaded file name "test-comic.cbz" and the bookmark entry "Page 1" visible in the Bookmarks tab.
